facts: Official ed9 is one production commit after stock3c7, 38 changed files. It adds durable PipelineEdge terminal state, failure propagation, cancel-before-join and remote Stop error settlement.

Old2ca did not contain this commit. Shared ancestry is stock3c7; official terminal semantics were not implied by our publication-failure cleanup. A no-conflict merge alone is not proof of compatibility.

Existing old2ca evidence has 5 new uninterrupted 39-table imports under22GiB, post125 and full TKE100G/1T. It remains valid only for that source; it will not be relabeled as integrated-source validation.

Historical same-configuration ed9 reference and old2ca have 42/44 normalized EXPLAINs identical. Q9 is identical at both scales; Q21 differs in one runtime filter at100G and aggregate hash-shuffle annotation at1T.

Old2ca1T Q9 median142.1095s versus ed992.144s; this is an observed difference. Source inspection proves additional global accounting work but has not yet proven the timing delta is caused by a particular helper.

Old2ca hashbuild copy loop invokes Batches.Allocated after each appended batch. That helper scans all retained batches/columns even when no import memory is reserved, giving cumulative quadratic metadata work.
goals: Official tag is an ancestor of final source and every official terminal/error cleanup contract survives unchanged in meaning.
Retain all import-memory invariants, supported-DAG boundaries, success semantics, byte limits, mixed-peer rejection policy and final five-round success under22GiB.
Every data/spool/working-set owner has one effective release on success, partial publication, error, cancellation, remote failure, retry and Reset->Free.
Ordinary SELECT does not pay repeated full retained-state scans or redundant per-row size work when a scoped budget/envelope is not required.
Remove demonstrated avoidable complexity while preserving exact pre-allocation admission and checked arithmetic; publish only after new-source functional/race/real-task/performance evidence.
non_goals: No implicit inclusion of moving-branch2846 frontend fix.
No persistent catalog/data-format/config change or new background worker, feature knob, data-specific limit or test-specific threshold.

pipeline_contract.official_authority: Retain ed9 PipelineEdge and its durable typed terminal state as the canonical completion/error protocol. Do not restore bare channel-only WaitRegister behavior or nil-only completion.
pipeline_contract.data_publication: Producer owns an unpublished copy and its leases until successful edge publication. Failed/cancelled publication discards that copy once through the effective owner. Published frames transfer to spool/receiver until consumer retirement.
pipeline_contract.terminal_linearization: Record End/Error/Abort durably and close edge Done independently of bounded data-channel capacity. Receiver drains already accepted data before synthesizing the durable terminal outcome; failure must not be converted into success by ctx cancellation.
pipeline_contract.spool_retirement: Use the official typed terminal cleanup/Abort/DiscardUnsent contracts. Integrate or delete obsolete MarkPublicationFailed/state where official ownership already closes the same arc; do not leave two independent frees of data/copy-pool state.
pipeline_contract.attempt_retirement: Join all producers/receivers/cleanup goroutines and settle remote terminal outcomes; retire saved PipelineSignalReceiver.currentSignal (including remote direct batches), then drain edge queued refs, then final-close spool slots/cache, clear owner registries and release attempt budget. A Reset panic must not strand current data outside Ch2.
pipeline_contract.error_priority: Preserve official remote Stop terminal decoding and primary-error selection. Cancel siblings on error before join, collect their terminal outcomes, and retain retry/execution errors rather than dropping them when a derived context is done.
pipeline_contract.reuse: Old callback/edge/spool generation must retire before Reset/Free publishes a reusable generation. Pre-registration and receiver publication remain ordered; no old handle can mutate a new generation.
pipeline_contract.no_double_protocol: Do not apply legacy nil acknowledgement timeout cleanup after successful typed terminal delivery. Failure/cancel control must remain independent of blocked data/receiver work.

accounting_contract.inherited: I sums complete attempt input promises, W denotes the process maximum concurrent IO envelope, D tracks actual retained data. Existing checked arithmetic, conservative physical accounting, v1/v2 mount sampling, NoWait txn policy and try-open compatibility remain.
accounting_contract.ordinary_select: Admission hooks remain scoped by the actual complete import contract. Shared helpers may retain generic spill correctness, but must not unconditionally evaluate expensive predictors when their result has no consumer.
accounting_contract.retained_bytes: Maintain exact retained allocation through bounded incremental deltas at allocation/transfer/reallocation/cleanup owners. One newly touched batch/column may be scanned to establish its bytes; do not scan all historical batches on every append. Reconcile terminal totals with an independent oracle in tests.
accounting_contract.key_encoding: Preserve variable-length and null-key capacity safety. Use batch/type-constant facts and reuse size results where valid; do not replace checked pre-extension with post-allocation rejection or assume fixed schema values.
accounting_contract.join_output: Preserve typed byte envelopes for controlled/spilling output. Avoid duplicate per-match/per-column size traversals and sizing work with no active bound while maintaining append/admission semantics.
accounting_contract.vector_copy: Preserve window/const/grouping/null correctness and exact shared-arena byte prediction, while avoiding a redundant full varlena scan on common unbounded copy paths when a valid O(1) capacity bound suffices.
accounting_contract.parameter_policy: No new timing/row/schema/table-specific constants; this is a cost/ownership correction, not a limit increase.

q1_q2_q3.Q1: Edge owns durable terminal state; producer owns unpublished copy; spool/receiver owns accepted data; attempt owns budget leases until effective terminal cleanup. Each transfer and destructor is mapped and exactly-once verified.
q1_q2_q3.Q2: Cancellation/error control records state and cancels siblings before joining. It cannot need data queue capacity or wait for work that only it can cancel. Remote settlement returns decoded terminal errors with bounded transport/context behavior.
q1_q2_q3.Q3: All queue/frame/retained-byte state retains an existing admission/capacity/lifetime bound. New accounting fields have constant size per existing owner and reset with that owner; no unbounded observer, map or log.

B1.decision: Separate cache-only once from final slot-destructor once; official slots become the authoritative occupancy state.
phase_order: During execution: SendBatch records ownedcopy; edge.SendData publication succeeds or the producer calls official DiscardUnsent exactly once per unnotified receiver.
Producer Reset publishes official durable terminal; End uses cache-only ForceCleanupAfterTerminalSignal, Error/cancel uses Abort. Neither invalidates borrowed current data.
Cancel siblings on fatal execution error before join; settle remote Stop and join every local producer/receiver/pipeline cleanup.
Only at this proven quiescent boundary, DrainForCleanup on every attempt edge to release remaining notification references (preserving terminal outcome); retire any saved current receiver refs.

Call each registered spool final CloseAfterReadersStopped exactly once under independent finalCleanupOnce and spool mutex: clean remaining slot-owned vectors, clear slot state/ref flags, then call cacheCleanupOnce/cleanupDone-compatible cache free.

Clear attempt spool/edge registrations and only then release attempt input/root ticket. Reuse resets edges only after old generation drain/final cleanup; remote and scope retained refs cannot outlive returned credit.
B1.once_rules: Official cleanupOnce remains cache-only and may already have run before readers stop. New finalCleanupOnce must never share that once. Slot clearing is idempotent; final cleanup uses existing official cleanSlotLocked and clears pointers before any later repeated call. No borrowed/current data is freed until quiescence.
B1.remove_duplicate_state: Remove obsolete occupied[] and publicationFailed generation flag when official slot-clearing/DiscardUnsent closes those arcs. Do not retain obsolete state or legacy CloseWithTimeout solely to satisfy old tests; map their ownership oracle to the new protocol.
oracles: typed End -> cache cleanup -> pending/current still readable -> edge drain -> final destructor -> every mpool byte/slot retired
Abort with shared current borrower -> pending reclaimed -> borrower remains valid -> ReleaseCurrent -> final destructor repeated safely
full Ch2 publication rejection -> only unnotified ref discarded -> subsequent frame order/terminal preserved
late fatal error and remote Stop retry error survive cleanup-derived cancellation; sender/receiver cancellation completes without timer timeout
Reset->Free and prepared reuse at quiescent boundary do not revive old edge/spool state
B1.saved_current_implementation: Register every real PipelineSignalReceiver into the existing process/attempt owner when initialized (prefer a common proc-aware Init point; otherwise audited colexec Prepare hooks including merge). At proven quiescence, idempotently releaseCurrent before edge drain. Cover all active controlled DAG receivers, not only send-side registrations. Count receiver registry capacity in metadata. Official operator Reset/Free may already have released it; the registry is the one effective final owner of any leftover ref.

B2.decision: Preallocate abort bookkeeping during admitted spool construction; terminal path never requests admission or allocates these arrays.
B2.representation: InitMyPipelineSpool allocates shardRefs []atomic.Int32 for every spool, including one receiver, and abortCurrentRefs []int32 of slots=max(2,receivers). abortLocked clears/reuses abortCurrentRefs under exclusive spool mutex and rebuilds current borrower counts without make. Only first abort executes; late release uses shardRefs. Single-receiver SendToAll keeps the no-refcheck fast path by receiver count rather than nil-array detection.
B2.bound: MemoryMetadataBound adds ClassAllocationSize(slots*sizeof(atomic.Int32)) unconditionally and ClassAllocationSize(slots*sizeof(int32)); PipelineSpool unsafe.Sizeof includes new slices and finalCleanupOnce. Remove occupied[] allocation charge if that array is deleted. Keep checked integer overflow, scanned/noscan headers, separately rounded receiver queues and combined hchan allocations. Constructor executes only after the inherited complete operator metadata/input bound is admitted on controlled paths.
B2.terminal_no_wait: Abort, durable terminal publication, edge drain, final cleanup and credit return do not acquire new I/D/W or request another array. They may use only already owned bookkeeping and existing official synchronization.
oracles: constructor metadata bound includes single and multi receiver arrays at allocator-class transitions and extreme fanout overflow
abort at fully reserved input/W/D capacity completes and frees only unborrowed data; no retry/admission path invoked
repeated Abort and final cleanup cannot allocate a second scratch array or double release a shared slot

B3.predicate: Resolve effective execution import view at Prepare. active = view != nil. A nonnil view with invalid UnitBytes is an error, never a silent ordinary fallback. outputLease presence is not the predicate because it can be an intermediate acquisition state.

cost_policy.hashjoin: Unbounded ordinary output follows original batch append and row checks with no outputRowBytes/boundedMatchCount/preExtendJoinValue forecast. Controlled fixed-width projections precompute checked conservative row width and cap a block by remainingBytes/rowWidth. Controlled variable-length output computes actual logical size once per selected match range and reuses count/bytes for append; avoid duplicate WindowSize traversals while preserving pre-allocation safety.
cost_policy.hashbuild: Guard unused accounting before evaluating arguments. When build reservation/spill is active, maintain bytes by changes to newly allocated/reallocated/retired batch columns; no unconditional full Batches.Allocated on every append. A full recount remains a test/terminal consistency oracle, not repeated production hot work. Preserve pre-copy capacity admission and build hash/key allocation bounds.
cost_policy.hashmap: Key size/null/varlen/overflow safety remains for all StrMap consumers. Optimize type-constant fixed widths and reuse size results; do not remove necessary exact capacity safety to improve speed.
cost_policy.vector: Keep correct compact/shared/const/window copying and all active forecast consumers. Eliminate only unused/redundant sizing work where the chosen copy operation preserves those same semantics; no original oversized shared-area retention bug may be restored.
cost_policy.other_global_costs: mpool atomic accounting, streaming codec and other ownership repairs are not removed speculatively. Use scoped CPU/alloc evidence and cheapest discriminating checks before changing them.

B4.statistic: Primary: median over measured full cycles of sum(q1..q22 execution milliseconds); exclude one warmup.100G3 cycles and1T2 as existing runner. Secondary: per-query median/min/max and raw cycle vectors; never substitute sum(query medians) for median(cycle sum). Publish every sample.
B4.noise_and_target: Goal is no slowdown of primary medians against a matched contemporaneous pinned-tag control. A slower candidate median cannot be stamped no-regression. Disjoint cycle ranges or all measured samples of a hot query above baseline range are deterministic flags of an observed material regression, not a p-value. Overlapping ranges require a noise assessment rather than best-run selection.
B4.fresh_control_trigger: Already triggered here: old2ca has slower100G/1T primary medians and Q9+54.2% despite largely identical EXPLAIN. Obtain a contemporary v4.1.6-hotfix-20261021(ed9) legacy3CN control with exact same harness, loader, CPU/memory/cache/merge policy and single-workload selection for the new candidate; oldstock3c7 run is not this control.
B4.bounded_repeat_policy: If the first contemporary pair remains ambiguous due crossing ranges or recorded infrastructure disturbance, one predeclared additional baseline/candidate pair may be taken, retaining all original results and comparing pooled samples. Do not discard failures, choose the fastest run, tune limits or repeat indefinitely to obtain a pass. An unresolved slower result remains a delivery blocker to investigate.
B4.profile_evidence: Use identical query-scoped selectors/time windows and record whether CPU/alloc/block profiles contain data. Current candidate/reference Q9 profiles are available; attribution must use disjoint caller buckets and not sum overlapping inclusive functions or convert CPU seconds into elapsed seconds.
B4.import_acceptance: Same22GiB/no-swap/4CPU and original39-input fixedorder/script/SQL:5 new uninterrupted rounds195 successes, zero client SQL/count retries/OOM/restarts, post125, all six owners/tasks zero after connection close and samePID alive. Record every round/table elapsed, CPU usage, IO bytes/calls, peakRSS/cgroup/effective pressure and actual fragment/flush counts. Do not introduce forcedGC/wait/changed profile overhead.
B4.import_performance_target: Compare new5-round wall-time median/CPUperGiB/IOcall and write-byte ratios with old2ca archived light-monitor5-round values only when initial state and observation are comparable. Otherwise mark historical timing as reference and run the smallest matched public import control on isolated fresh stores; target no new median/CPUperGiB regression and no increased fragmentation/IO calls from the integration. Do not label a slower unexplained import result acceptable merely because it completes.
B4.accounting_complexity_target: Normal SELECT output has no import-sizing callbacks; active build accounting work is amortized O(new batch columns/rows), not O(all historical batches per append). Deterministic callback/work counters and exact byte oracles prove this independently of wall-clock variance.
B4.delivery: Every target gets a final measured table. Pending/noisy/unmatched evidence is explicit and cannot close the no-regression gate.

B5.new_server: For admission open and try-open require a nonnil complete producer manifest with Version==3 before registering/reserving/reclaiming. Reject Version0/2/4 and absent manifests. Close and terminal cleanup for a previously valid service/connection-bound token remain idempotent and do not require a manifest.

This experimental pre-release direction is explicitly unsupported for transparent success. Released ed9 clients have no such internal feature and continue ordinary legacy execution.
